text: Good morning, cadet. This morning you're on the engine telegraph. Repeat every engine order, loud and clear.
Engine room, bridge. Stand by engine. Pilot at seven.
Bridge, engine room. Standing by. Engine tested ahead and astern. Rudder tested, hard over both sides. All OK.
Engine is slow ahead. Captain, why so slow?
The pilot boat comes alongside at about eight knots. We need to be slow and steady.
Morning, Captain. The berthing plan from the port: two tugs. One will make fast forward, one aft.
Good. Our lines will go on their towing hooks. Port side alongside, on the big fenders of the gas berth.
Good. In one hour, the pilot. And then, cadet, you take the wheel.
Diego, what's the engine on now?
Bridge, engine room. Engine ready, standing by.
Tug one will make fast forward.
We'll be at the pilot station in fifteen minutes.
